About AKSH

Mental wellness, without the stigma.

AKSH is a psychology practice founded by Meghana Kaverappa to make counselling and mental health support easy to reach, for individuals, schools, colleges and workplaces.

Meet the founder
AKSHMENTAL WELLNESSA safe space for every mind

Our mark.

Two open hands hold a young sprout. Purple for calm and depth, gold for warmth and hope. It is how we want you to feel here: held, and free to grow.

A safe space for every mind.

What we believe.

Safety comes first

You should never have to prove your pain to deserve support. Every session starts with feeling safe.

Confidential by default

What you share stays between you and your psychologist, within the limits of safety and the law.

Ask early

Help works best before things feel unbearable. Stress, worry and low mood are all fair reasons to talk.

Wellness is for everyone

Students, parents, teachers, engineers and managers. No one needs a label to walk in.

How a session works.

  1. Tell us what is going onUse the booking form. Share only what you are comfortable with.
  2. Agree a timeWe confirm a slot with you, online or in person.
  3. Talk it throughA private conversation at your pace, with next steps if you want them.

Where we work.

Online across India, from wherever you feel most comfortable. In person in Bengaluru when you need it.

What AKSH is not. We are not an emergency service. Psychologists do not prescribe medication, so when you need a doctor or psychiatrist we will say so and help you find the right next step.

    Breathe and ground

    Two small tools for hard moments.

    Slow breathing and grounding both tell your body that you are safe enough right now. Try one for a minute.

    FAQ

    Answers before you ask.

    If your question is not here, message us on Instagram or WhatsApp and we will reply.

    Is what I share confidential?

    Yes. What you share stays between you and your psychologist. The exceptions are when there is a serious risk to your safety or someone else's, or when the law requires it. We explain this before you begin.

    Do you offer online sessions?

    Yes. Sessions are online first, on a video call from wherever you feel comfortable, anywhere in India.

    Can I meet in person?

    Yes, on request in Bengaluru. Tell us when you book and we will arrange it.

    Who can come to AKSH?

    Adults, teenagers and children, along with parents, schools, colleges and companies. You do not need a diagnosis to start.

    Can my child see a psychologist?

    Yes. Meghana works with children and adolescents and involves parents where it helps. Tell us your child's age when you book.

    How much does it cost?

    Fees depend on the type of session or program. Message us and we will share the details before you book anything.

    How do I book?

    Fill in the form on the Book page and send the message to us on Instagram or WhatsApp. We will agree a time together.

    Do you diagnose or prescribe medication?

    Psychologists do not prescribe medication. If you may need a doctor or psychiatrist, we will tell you and help you find the right next step.

    Is AI Aksh a real therapist?

    No. AI Aksh is an AI companion for support in everyday moments. It cannot diagnose or treat. It is a gentle first step, not a replacement for a session with Meghana.

    What if I am in crisis?

    Please do not wait for an appointment. In India, Tele-MANAS offers free support on 14416, round the clock. For immediate danger, call 112, or reach someone you trust right now.

    Can you run programs at our school or company?

    Yes. See the pages for schools and colleges and for workplaces, then tell us your needs on the Book page.
